verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents ephemeral, authenticated connections for GitHub-hosted runners, running in Docker containers and as a Kubernetes sidecar with authentication, embedding via the tsnet Go package, an official CLI, and infrastructure-as-code automation. Together these clearly cover headless and CI use. A community report that API keys expire after 60 days and need manual renewal is a caveat for long-running automation, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on non-interactive auth key handling (the evidence is one-line summaries), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and a fix for the reported key-expiry friction.
